description: This file contains shell script functions for upgrading and boot management of specific Realtek-based devices with dual-boot configurations. It defines procedures to set boot partitions, perform upgrade steps, and handle device-specific partition schemes.

methods.name: set_boot_part
methods.description: Configures the boot environment variables depending on device model and selected partition, preparing the system to boot from the specified partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_dualboot_plasmacloud
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process in a dual-boot setup, handling detection of inactive firmware partition, copying new firmware, and updating boot environment variables accordingly.
